purpose: Regression contract for a collective closed-month historical snapshot ledger that stays outside live operations.

cases.expect: Master Data is historical only; live operational sheets own current state.
Closed month is archived as static values/text with no live formulas or cross-sheet dependencies.
Archive and read-back verification finish before destructive paired cleanup/reset.
Append to an established collective archive instead of creating a competing history system.
Archive fields are mapped by verified semantic headers; redundant live columns need not be duplicated automatically.
Older months may be blank for later fields; backfill requires authoritative evidence.
A complete existing month block blocks a second append; ambiguity fails closed.
Closed history is immutable by default; proven repair requires explicit amendment, checkpoint, read-back, and audit.
Established sentinel rows are structural month boundaries and survive operational cleanup.
Derived helper history does not count the same Master Data month as independent extra evidence.
Legacy Excel existence alone does not force staging; only required newer/unreconciled authoritative evidence does.
When the Owner migrates routine operations to Google Sheets, the authorized Google workbook is canonical and legacy Excel is reference/migration evidence rather than a routine synchronization gate.
